headline: Cost impact not mentioned: NAT gateway spending will roughly double

findings.evidence_ref: Terraform plan creates aws_nat_gateway.b and aws_eip.nat_b; each NAT gateway costs approximately $32-45/month plus data processing charges
findings.explanation: Adding a second NAT gateway for high availability will roughly double monthly NAT gateway costs, but this financial impact is not mentioned in the pull request description. The decision-maker needs to know the cost trade-off before merging.
